title: Week 3 Tutorials — Premiere Pro: Color Correction & Basic Timing
description: These tutorials introduce foundational post-production techniques in Adobe Premiere Pro, with a focus on basic color correction for winter footage, understanding the difference between correction and grading, and making subtle, intentional adjustments. The goal is to improve clarity, contrast, and consistency in a static outdoor scene, while avoiding heavy stylization. An optional tutorial on clip speed introduces basic timing adjustments when needed.

children.title: Intro to Color Correction
children.description: An overview of Lumetri Color in Premiere Pro focused on basic color correction, including reading luma scopes, adjusting contrast and exposure, and making subtle color corrections using RGB curves and Hue vs. Hue.

children.title: Intro to Color Grading
children.description: This tutorial focuses on color grading in Premiere Pro, including color management, hue curves, color wheels, vignettes, and masks. These tools are used for stylistic decisions, not for fixing exposure or balance issues, which should be addressed during color correction first.

children.title: How to COLOR GRADE Winter Footage
children.description: This tutorial demonstrates how to correct common winter color issues such as flat contrast and color cast, and then explores optional stylized winter grading in Adobe Premiere Pro.

children.title: 4 Easy Tips for Color Correction in Premiere Pro
children.description: This tutorial introduces four practical tips for color correction in Adobe Premiere Pro. It covers using the appropriate correction tools, working efficiently with the Lumetri Color panel, establishing proper exposure and white balance, and using the Vectorscope to check skin tones and color balance.

children.title: How to Add SMOOTH SLOW MOTION
children.description: This tutorial demonstrates how to slow down video clips in Adobe Premiere Pro to create smooth slow motion. It covers adjusting clip speed, maintaining smooth playback, and understanding how frame rate affects slow-motion results.
